scope: Single diagnostic with service and WSI probes; no causal FPS comparison or physical scanout claim

present_limit_activation.scope: Existing present pacing sleeps guest service thread; no game-clock or swap-word override.

clock.mapping: Exact mapped libstdc++ disassembly in pacing-steady-clock-proof.json uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC; no libc++ substitution.

sleep_excess_ms.rounding: Each native field is rounded to0.001ms before subtraction; not an exact wake timestamp.

vsync.scope: Global VI2 vsync callback aggregates, conservatively enclosed using two previous observations; not Kernel::Sleep resumption and not exact aggregate duration.

visual_review.scene: Kokiri Forest name visible at readiness; Link on original platform, terrain, foliage, houses, ladder opening and HUD visible. Before/after retain the same platform/camera view; animated leaves differ.
visual_review.limits: Static composite screenshots only; no free ground route, full-world, audio, save/resume or temporal image-quality qualification.

analysis_parser_note: Initial offline parser rejected ANSI reset suffix on source=vi2_service; corrected to strip formatting only, raw logs unchanged. Actual native colored-line positive twin plus13 prior negatives pass. No rerun or source/binary change.
limits: WSI accepted SUCCESS/SUBOPTIMAL returns, not scanout or distinct contents.
VI2 frame records are rate-limited samples, not all-frame CPU or wake distributions.
Vsync aggregate duration is conservatively bounded, not exact; first two records excluded.
Nearest-rank quantiles remain per600 interval window; no averaged/global quantile.
Diagnostic probes add clocks and logging; no performance-gain claim.
The90 rate-limited service records are not representative all-frame percentiles or a critical-path budget.
Sleep excess includes service rescheduling and return, not only HostTiming timer wake; requested/actual fields rounded.
WSI and VI2 windows have different anchors and cover different portions; do not pair them as the same frames.
All WSI observed windows report generation1/segment1, no rejection; rejected/recreate behavior here is CPU-tested, not triggered on this GPU.
Framegen false; repeated guest content remains possible.
Small sleep excess in observed samples does not prove all irregular intervals have another cause.
Goal constant30/fullgame clock, motion, audio and save/zone quality still unqualified.
decision: Both service requests and accepted Vulkan returns have ~30/s mean but ~46ms per-window p99. Observed sampled sleep overshoot small; no all-frame cause ruled out. Next isolated configuration control sets native frame_pacing_mode1 (Target30), keeping all other settings and probes.
